title: danny-avila/LibreChat provides a self-hosted interface for models and agents
friendlyTitle: LibreChat is a self-hosted home for many AI models and agents
summary: LibreChat is an open-source, multi-user chat interface supporting numerous model providers, agents, MCP, tools, code execution and authentication. It ranked third among today’s eligible unpublished AI repositories in the captured Trending results, with a score of 294 and roughly 43,500 total stars.
friendlySummary: LibreChat gives teams one chat interface for many AI providers, tools and agents. It was the third-highest eligible AI repository in today’s captured Trending results.
whyItMatters: Organisations can offer a consistent interface across multiple providers while retaining control over deployment and user access. Self-hosting still requires disciplined upgrades, secret management, tool permissions and monitoring, especially when agents can execute code or reach internal systems.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Teams can manage several AI services in one place. Administrators still need to protect keys, update the software and tightly control powerful tools.
